title: 第七章 努力成为妈妈的伊尔莎
slug: 不正经的异世界攻略手册
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“呼...”

伊尔莎擦了擦额头，将刚挤出的新鲜牛奶提了起来，

这是最后一头奶牛了，完成之后，今天的工作就结束了。

将牛棚收拾了一下，添上了新鲜的草料后，接着提起牛奶，放进了地窖内保存，

“玛拉太太，牛棚已经收拾好了，奶牛们也都挤好奶了。”伊尔莎向奶牛农场主汇报道。

“辛苦了，亲爱的，才几天你干活就这么利索，有了你我现在都轻松多了。”这位三十来岁，身材丰满的不像样子的牛人种妇女眯眼笑着说道。

“还是有不少东西需要学习的。”伊尔莎不好意思地说道。

“唉...正好是牧场里忙碌的时候，我丈夫他又去了海外出差，这附近也难招到人手，也还好有你在这里，能帮我解决一部分的苦恼...”玛拉说道。

“没关系，玛拉太太，还有其他什么需要我帮忙的地方也尽管说就行了。”伊尔莎很积极的说道。

“嚯嚯，亲爱的，另一部分你可就帮不了我哦~”丰满的牛人种妇女稍微胸前的丰满，朝她露出一个意味深长的笑容。

“呃...这样啊...”稍微有点反应过来的伊尔莎有点尴尬的说道。

“不过你也真辛苦呀，这么小就要出来工作，唉...你那瘫痪在床的父亲还好吧？”玛拉问道。

“啊...嗯，都，都还好吧....”伊尔莎心虚说道。

刚来这里的时候，为了能让别人接受自己，特意编了一个需要照顾瘫床老父亲的悲惨身世，结果发现不需要这种借口也能得到这份工作，但话也说出去了，自然没法再改口。

“来，这是你今天的工钱，收好可别掉了。”玛拉拿出了钱包，将几张钞票递给她。

“这，今天的多了不少啊。”伊尔莎看着手里的钱说道。

“没事，亲爱的，你做的很好，一个人就能抵我两个工人呢，本来说还需要招一个的，但现在看来也不需要了。”玛拉太太温和的笑道。

“那，那好吧，谢谢你，玛拉太太。”伊尔莎微红着脸颊，还是收下了这笔钱。

收拾好后，换上了自己的外套，拿上一瓶牛奶后，她和玛拉太太告辞，离开了奶牛农庄，

步行了半个小时左右，回到了现在的住处，那个老旧的三层小屋。

回来之后先去了鸡窝，取了玉米碎喂鸡，又收了今天下的四枚鸡蛋，这才进了屋。

“亚枫，我回来...”

“你户口本不想要了是吧敢这么和我说话？！”

一进去，就听到了客厅里传来的喝骂声，接着就看到亚枫站了起来，恼火的就要往外冲。

"Huh..."

Ilsa wiped her forehead and picked up the freshly squeezed milk.

This is the last cow, and once that's done, the day's work is over.

After tidying up the cowshed and adding fresh fodder, he picked up the milk and put it in the cellar for storage.

"Mrs. Mara, the cowshed has been packed and the cows have been milked." Ilsa reported to the dairy farmer.

"Thank you, my dear, you've been working so neatly for just a few days. I feel much more relaxed now that I have you." This woman in her thirties, plump and unattractive, said with a squinted smile.

"There are still a lot of things to learn." Ilsa said sheepishly.

"Sigh... It happened to be a busy time in the ranch, and my husband went on a business trip overseas. It's hard to find people around here. Fortunately, you are here to help me solve part of my troubles..." Mara said.

"It's okay, Mrs. Mara, if there is anything else you need my help with, just ask." Ilsa said positively.

"Hoho, dear, you can't help me with the other part~" The plump, ox-human woman slightly plumped up her chest and showed her a meaningful smile.

"Uh...that's it..." Ilsa said a little embarrassedly after she finally reacted.

"But it's really hard for you. You have to go to work at such a young age. Oh...how is your father who is paralyzed in bed?" Mara asked.

"Ah...well, everything is okay..." Ilsa said with a guilty conscience.

When I first came here, in order to make others accept me, I deliberately made up a tragic life story in which I needed to take care of my old father who was paralyzed in bed. It turned out that I could get the job without such an excuse, but after I said it, I couldn't change it.

"Here, here is your wages for today. Keep it and don't drop it." Mara took out her wallet and handed her a few bills.

"Here, there are a lot more today." Ilsa said, looking at the money in her hand.

"It's okay, my dear, you're doing a great job. One person is worth two of my workers. Originally, we needed to recruit one more, but it seems we don't need one now." Mrs. Mara smiled gently.

"Well, then, thank you, Mrs. Mara." Ilsa blushed slightly, but accepted the money.

After packing up, she put on her coat and got a bottle of milk. She said goodbye to Mrs. Mara and left the dairy farm.

After walking for about half an hour, I returned to my current residence, the old three-story hut.

After coming back, I went to the chicken coop first, got ground corn to feed the chickens, and collected the four eggs laid today before entering the house.

"Yafeng, I'm back..."

"You don't want your registered permanent residence at all, do you dare to talk to me like this?!"

As soon as he entered, he heard shouts and curses coming from the living room, and then saw Ya Feng standing up, and was about to rush out in anger.
